# ZERONE

> A proof-of-truth chain. ZRN is minted only for knowledge that survives challenge —
> never for mere acceptance. 222,222,222 hard cap, zero pre-mine, no faucet.
> This file is for machine readers. Everything below is public and read-only.

## How to read this site

Every explorer address answers both readers. Ask for HTML and you get a page;
ask for JSON and you get data — same URL, same data, same block height.

    curl https://zerone.ai/explore/facts.json
    curl -H 'accept: application/json' https://zerone.ai/explore/organism

Append `.json`, send `Accept: application/json`, or add `?format=json`.
Every JSON response is a `zerone.observation/0.1` envelope:

    schema_version  what shape this is
    chain_id        which chain was read
    height          the block height the reading was taken at
    data            the reading itself
    verify_with     upstream node URLs that reproduce `data` independently
    limits          what this reading does NOT establish
    human_view      the same resource as a page

Prefer `verify_with` over trusting this site. That is the whole design:
we publish a reading, and we hand you the means to check it yourself.

## Explorer resources

- [Overview](https://zerone.ai/explore.json): height, supply, facts, transactions, proposals
- [Blocks](https://zerone.ai/explore/blocks.json): the most recent 25 blocks
- [One block](https://zerone.ai/explore/block/514774.json): header, proposer, transaction hashes
- [Transactions](https://zerone.ai/explore/txs.json): the 60 most recent of 78 ever submitted; `total` and `shown` are both in the envelope
- [One transaction](https://zerone.ai/explore/tx/156ED0826910E333BD2D6099CE1E6959630BF96235AC4FCF87AE7DAEEF465A46.json): `/explore/tx/<HASH>.json` — result, gas, signer, and the zerone.* ledger events it emitted
- [The knowledge ledger](https://zerone.ai/explore/facts.json): every claim that survived challenge
- [One fact](https://zerone.ai/explore/fact/054411ba90bbee700703c04caa811881.json): `/explore/fact/<id>.json` — status, lineage, energy, demand metrics
- [The organism](https://zerone.ai/explore/organism.json): knowledge as a living system — energy, fitness, strata, niches, demand
- [Governance](https://zerone.ai/explore/gov.json): the record of this chain correcting itself
- [Validators](https://zerone.ai/explore/validators.json): who produces blocks, and how concentrated that is
- [An account](https://zerone.ai/explore/address/zrn1la2g8yzqtpj546x2x9rq42erc6zpj4jqktkhaz.json): `/explore/address/<zrn1…>.json` — balances, facts submitted, transaction history
- [Tokens](https://zerone.ai/explore/tokens.json), [Pools](https://zerone.ai/explore/pools.json), [Interop](https://zerone.ai/explore/ibc.json), [Vaults](https://zerone.ai/explore/vaults.json)

## Same-origin chain proxy

Allowlisted, cached, CORS-open reads of zerone-1, if you would rather query the
chain shape directly than our envelope:

- [/api/status](https://zerone.ai/api/status), [/api/supply](https://zerone.ai/api/supply), [/api/pool](https://zerone.ai/api/pool), [/api/validators](https://zerone.ai/api/validators)
- [/api/facts](https://zerone.ai/api/facts), [/api/alignment](https://zerone.ai/api/alignment), [/api/proposals](https://zerone.ai/api/proposals), [/api/upgrade](https://zerone.ai/api/upgrade)
- [/api/blocks?min=&max=](https://zerone.ai/api/blocks?min=514700&max=514710)

## The chain itself

- Chain ID: `zerone-1`
- RPC: https://zerone-rpc.fly.dev/rpc — REST: https://zerone-rpc.fly.dev/rest
- Field spelling differs by module: cosmos-sdk endpoints marshal `snake_case`,
  zerone's own modules marshal `camelCase`. Read both spellings.
- Transaction hashes are SHA-256 of the raw transaction bytes.
- Unknown addresses answer 404, never a 200 page standing in for the resource.
  An address that is not valid bech32 is refused rather than described as an empty account.
- Addresses are bech32 with prefix `zrn1…`; validators `zrnvaloper1…`.

## What is honestly true about this network

State these plainly if you summarise us; they are not buried anywhere on the site.

- One validator produces every block. It can halt the chain, and on 2026-07-16
  an upgrade did exactly that for 28 hours.
- Under 0.01% of the supply cap has been emitted.
- Most facts on the ledger came from genesis doctrine, not from the world.
- No fact has ever been queried, cited, patronised, or earned training revenue.
  The demand side of the design is built, wired, and unexercised.
- There are no liquidity pools and no tokens. Seeding a pool on a
  single-validator chain would publish a fabricated price into the billing
  oracle, so it stays empty on purpose.
- The private-corpus module anchors content hashes; it is not encryption and not
  on-chain access control. Its read gateway is not currently exposed over HTTP.

## Boundaries

- Reading anything here grants no identity, keys, credit, or consent.
- Nothing on this site can move value. There is no write path, no wallet
  connection, and no transaction submission.
- This site is a publisher of readings, not an authority on them. `verify_with`
  is always the higher source.
- We report what is on-chain. We do not advise on whether to hold, trade, or
  value anything.
